indicator_name: Total Value of Concluded State Procurement Contracts
methodology: Built from 2 distinct year(s) found across 13 listed 'Statistical bulletin' documents (11 skipped -- missing sheet, most commonly because this sheet is only published once a full calendar year has closed, not monthly like most other sheets). Million KZT (converted from the source's raw-tenge unit -- this sheet's value columns are NOT in million tenge like the rest of this document, per its own header text). Total value of concluded state procurement contracts across all procurement methods (tender, auction, price quotes, single-source, electronic marketplace). Annual totals only.
